about_the_game:
Valkyrie Saga is an indie, retro platformer styled after PSX classics, giving you a chance to embark on an epic odyssey! Play as Roll the Valkyrie, a divine warrior tasked by the gods with one mission: Stopping a floating island from crashing into the earth. Ascend the ancient skyborne land, explore ancient ruins full of enigmatic carvings, unlock their secrets - and stop the cataclysm!



Everything in Valkyrie Saga is designed to make you feel like a PSX player from 1994. From stunning graphics from the time, through the immersive soundtrack, to the most memorable thing that kept players glued to TV screens: Gameplay!



As the divine warrior, you'll have to master both the art of soaring across the skies across the plummeting island, and the way of the blade, confronting otherworldly foes!



Hidden among the ruins, cryptic scribblings, and odd twists of the world is a complex story to piece together, detailing what happened to the civilization that once occupied the island. Can you find out the truth before it is too late?

short_description: Join Roll the Valkyrie as she subverts fate in a retro indie platformer taking after PSX classics. Climb, dash, jump, and glide your way up a falling sky island, to stop it from destroying the world below. A straightforward quest that soon turns out to be much, much more...
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America
